notes: TITLE WITHHELD: published title 'DA SHIZNIT- Palpys Influence' uses 'shiznit' (slang for a swear word); the page uses 'Alex George Palpys Influence DS' ('Alex George DS' and 'Alex George Bring Him Before Me DS' are already taken) and the published title stays only in the source citation.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': the Objective (posted 'BHBM/Busta Cap in yo A$$'), Insignificant Rebellion, Your Destiny, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Death Star II: Throne Room (posted 'Palpy's Ruckuss Room') and 'Any other Effect'. 'Any other Effect' is not a card: the header 'Effects (9)+1 for the start' lists 10 Effects, one of which starts. Total 60 as published.
Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. Battle Order, No Escape, Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are the Effects (not the later Defensive Shields).
